summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the AI data-center electrical balance-of-system node. The reference anchor is Vertiv because its 2026 investor materials explicitly frame AI power architecture evolution around MV/LV switchgear, UPS, 800VDC sidecars, BESS/UPS and power conversion. The underfollowed lane is best represented by Powell Industries, nVent Electric, and IES Holdings: Powell supplies custom-engineered electrical distribution/control systems and has direct management commentary tying backlog and capacity expansion to data-center and AI build-outs; nVent has data-center PDUs, switchgear/bus systems, enclosures and modular electrical-building exposure after Avail/Trachte; IES is a contractor/infrastructure-products name whose 2026 filing says data-center demand is particularly strong across Communications, Infrastructure Solutions and Commercial & Industrial, with labor/capacity as a constraint.
